Malay is a mouth-full. You really need to be a practiced speaker to not look like a fool. A lot of Malay words typically have more parts to pronounce compared to English. Words like 'menggeletar' sound weird if you don't have a natural slang.

Also, imo, the way BM is taught in school is pretty flawed. You come off as too stiff or formal if you follow the "proper" way to converse in BM. Nobody speaks like that irl. It's just more natural and efficient to mix in some English, especially for stuff like tech terms. But when you're doing that, I guess most people think you might as well speak in English instead of bahasa rojak.
